Velodrome's web domain was hijacked through a registrar compromise on November 29, 2023. The attacker redirected users to phishing sites which tricked them into approving token transfers, leading to losses estimated up to $250,000. Velodrome core contracts remained unaffected. The incident was caused by a DNS hijack enabled through multiple social engineering attacks against the domain registrar. The attacker bypassed 2FA and changed the nameservers, redirecting Velodrome users to fake websites that prompted malicious wallet approvals. No Velodrome core contract or on-chain logic was breached.
